nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=68 beats='first snow day on Maple Hill; Priya age eight and her brother Arun age four stand at the top after one last run; Arun lifts a foot wearing only a soaked sock; the red boot with the peeling yellow star sticker on the heel is gone; the crossing whistle blows at four and Grandma Nita waits in the blue car; Priya counts three places to start looking'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Priya tows the red saucer sled down the packed lane while Arun rides on it; sled tracks cross and braid over each other; she turns up a striped mitten and a juice box lid but no boot; snow packs deepest in three spots along the run; Arun sings a made up song to keep his cold foot busy'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the plow ridge stands taller than Priya, gray and crusted hard; she chips at it with the edge of the saucer sled; a boot toe appears and her heart jumps; the boot is black and far too big for Arun; somebody lost this one first and never came back for it'>>

choices.label: Carry the black boot to the hut

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='at the bottom of the run the hay bales sit frozen hard as benches; sleds thump them and stop; straw and snow pack together underneath them; a dark gap runs behind the row where the wind whistles through; Wren is restacking a long toboggan close by and looks up'>>

choices.label: Ask Wren to tip a bale

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the fence line holds the post everyone calls the mitten tree; lost mittens and one small hat hang stiff with frost; whoever finds a thing on Maple Hill hangs it here for later; Priya scans the whole row twice; past the post the fence bends away toward the plow turn'>>

choices.label: Follow the fence to the plow turn

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Priya digs deeper into the plow ridge until her fingers sting through wet mittens; the crust breaks open into a hollow that smells like cold stone; something red shows far back in the dark; Biscuit the crossing dog trots up with his nose working hard; Arun hops closer to see'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Priya lugs the heavy black boot up the packed path toward the warming hut door while Arun hops behind her in one sock'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Priya squeezes into the gap behind the bales where the air smells like cold straw; the light goes thin and blue; a corner of red rubber shows under packed snow near a wooden stake; beside her knee the ground opens where the creek runs underneath the hill'>>

choices.label: Back out and mark the spot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=42 beats='Mrs. Delgado takes the black boot and says a girl carried a red one down to the culvert pipe; she also tips her chin at the lost and found crate under the bench; the hut clock reads ten to four'>>

choices.label: Run down to the culvert pipe
Dig through the lost and found

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='further along the fence the plow has scraped a dip full of loose snow; small paw prints ring the whole dip; a curl of red shows under the crust and a second red shape lies right beside it; Arun says both of them look like his and Priya kneels down'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the warming hut breathes cocoa steam and wet wool; Mrs. Delgado runs the plywood counter with a clipboard of names; a big crate of lost things sits under the long bench; kids thaw their red hands against the stove pipe and argue about who is fastest'>>

choices.label: Ask Mrs. Delgado to call out
Dig in the lost and found crate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Mrs. Delgado cups her hands and calls the whole hut to listen for a small red boot with a star on the heel; two answers come back, one about the mitten tree post and one about the plow driver shifting a pile; the toes of Arun are turning pink'>>

choices.label: Run straight to the mitten tree

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the lost and found crate holds odd gloves, one ski, a purple boot, and a scarf gone crunchy with ice; Priya digs to the bottom with both arms; under the scarf a red boot lies wedged sideways; Arun leans over the crate on his one good foot'>>

choices.label: Check the heel for the star

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Mrs. Delgado slides a bread bag and then a giant dry wool sock over the wet foot of Arun so he can walk further'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='out at the fence the wind pushes hard and the light goes flat and blue; the four whistle is only minutes away; Arun walks slower and slower behind her; on the mitten tree post something red hangs by knotted laces just above the snow'>>

choices.label: Untie the boot from the post

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Priya tips the whole crate onto the hut floor and Mrs. Delgado raises one eyebrow at the pile; the clipboard lists who carried each thing inside; two names stand out, Wren from the hay bales and the plow driver; the stove ticks and Arun shivers'>>

choices.label: Ask Wren about the hay bales

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=42 beats='with a warm dry foot Arun can walk all the way to the gate; the plow truck idles there with its amber light turning slow; the driver rolls his window down and the hut clock behind them reads four'>>

choices.label: Ask the plow driver to look

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='paw prints from Biscuit stitch a neat line across fresh snow away from the sled run; Mr. Okafor whistles for him from the crossing while holding his orange sign; at a stump the prints split, one line heading toward the creek and one heading back toward the road'>>

choices.label: Follow the prints to the creek

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='the frozen creek ticks and creaks under its skin of ice; the culvert pipe mouth breathes warm gray air into the cold; dry reeds rattle and the tail of Biscuit swings above them; something wet and red lies near the pipe where the gravel shows through'>>

choices.label: Call Biscuit out of the reeds
Kneel and look in the pipe

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Mr. Okafor holds his orange sign at the crossing and remembers a red boot riding down the hill on the nose of a toboggan; he offers the real snow shovel from his truck and points back at the plow ridge; he also carries paper and a pencil stub in his coat'>>

choices.label: Draw a map of the hill

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Biscuit bounds out of the reeds carrying something soggy and red; he drops it, snatches it up again, and starts a game of keep away along the bank; Priya has one granola bar left in her pocket; Arun laughs out loud for the first time all afternoon'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Priya kneels at the culvert mouth where warm air and gravel meet the ice and spots a dark shape wedged deep inside the pipe'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='the real shovel bites where the saucer sled could not; heavy wet chunks break away from the plow ridge and thud on the path; four is very close now and Arun hops from foot to foot; a scrap of red shows deep in the fresh cut'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=42 beats='the shape is the red boot with the yellow star, jammed farther in than her arm can reach; a bare willow stick lies frozen on the bank; Biscuit whines at the pipe mouth and the four whistle is close'>>

choices.label: Hook it out with the stick

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='the red boot comes back with ice melting off the yellow star; Arun stamps the foot down twice to be sure it is really his; they reach the blue car of Grandma Nita just as the whistle fades; the heater vents roar and Arun names the boot Star'>>

ending.title: Two Boots at the Blue Car

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='two small red boots sit side by side and look exactly alike; Priya turns each heel over and only one of them carries the peeling yellow star; Arun shouts that the star is his proof; the other boot goes back in the crate for whoever comes looking'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='the red boot hangs by knotted laces on the mitten tree post with the star turned out toward the hill; a stranger hung it there for whoever came back; Arun pulls it on over his wet sock and they walk home along the fence counting frozen mittens'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='Biscuit digs, sneezes, and drops the soggy red boot at the feet of Arun; Priya trades him the granola bar and thanks Mr. Okafor twice; the star sticker has curled up at one corner; Arun hugs the wet boot the whole way to the blue car'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='no boot turns up before four; Mrs. Delgado wraps the foot of Arun in a bread bag inside a huge wool sock; two cocoas warm their hands at the counter; she writes their phone number on the clipboard and promises to call the minute a red boot comes in'>>

ending.title: One Boot and a Bread Bag

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='a red rubber toe pokes out of the packed pile and Priya works it free with the edge of her saucer sled; ice fills the star sticker like a little window; she knocks the boot twice against the fence to empty it out; Arun stomps his foot down and grins'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='no boot today, so Priya draws Maple Hill on paper with the plow ridge, the hay bales, the mitten tree, and the culvert pipe; Mr. Okafor marks an X where he last saw red; they agree to come back at nine and Arun carries the map home flat against his chest'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='at the creek bend Priya hooks the red boot loose and lands flat on her elbows in the snow; she pours out gravel and cold water and one surprised beetle; the yellow star is still stuck fast to the heel; Arun claps with both mittens and calls her the best sister'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill while Priya is still digging; the toes of Arun have gone hard and cold inside the wet sock; Grandma Nita waves them in with one boot missing; the chest of Priya feels tight until Arun says they can hunt again tomorrow'>>
